findings.text: Result_b phone card shows a large unlabelled '0' under a dashed flag for DeepSeek. No unit, no denominator, and the very next beat (56.3-57.0) shows DeepSeek writing 'carries a strong forced-labour...'. Reads as 'DeepSeek flagged nothing', which the recording contradicts. Drop the 0 or label it as final answers kept.

Born_third: the mint 35% strip sits on top of the passport's second MRZ line, so '1<OF<2' is half-hidden and reads as a clipped glitch (frames 30.45 to 33.02). Move the strip clear of the MRZ or lift the MRZ above it.

Lives page is near-empty (only the AI placeholder) from 37.5 to about 41 s while 'sees your data' is spoken; the DeepSeek/CHINA stamp only lands at 41.28. Born page is also bare for the first second (21.67). Previous 'never empty' fix is only partly met; land the first stamp or flag within about 0.8 s of each page opening.

Mint is used as type colour in three places: 'AT STAKE' (1.5), 'DEEPSEEK' label on the phone card (59.5) and 'DEEPSEEK WROTE' under the pull quote (56.3-58.4). Template says mint never type; use cream/ink and keep mint to fills and highlights.
Result_a: the white loop around the Claude card reaches up to the base of the headline 'THREE.' and brushes it; re-aim lower so it clears the headline.

Evidence beat works: types in 56.3 (partial), full at 57.0, caption 'then deletes' at 57.6 with text still up, deleted state ('Sorry, that's beyond my current scope') at 58.0 and held to 58.4. Delete lands in about 0.4 s, so it is brisk; the real recording is untouched. The recording's own text is small (native), carried by the pull quote below.

'ANSWER DELETED' tag on the infographic and 'DEEPSEEK WROTE' on the quote are annotation labels that edge toward process labels. They serve the message, so I do not block; cut if Krish reads them as labels. The phone card re-typesets the deleted reply as a quote, not a redraw of the recording; acceptable.

Act_a: the 'WHICH AI' and 'WHERE IT LIVES' pills repeat the dek 'Which AI they use, and where it lives.' Redundant but legible, no overlap. The checkmark scribble on 70.42 sits over the 'AI' placeholder and hides it; fine.

Hook opens on a blank ink frame with only logo and pill for under 0.8 s, then the stakes headline USING A CHINESE AI? with the phone 'At stake' glass is in by 1.5 s. Previous fix verified; the first 0.4 s is still empty, so consider a faster first picture.

Ending verified: ONE closing screen, no ticker or marquee anywhere (75.58, 76.5, 78.3). The ending band sits over the passport page art and the page is static for about 3 s; acceptable. Verified fixed: phone prompt chip gone, Chesky to Bloomberg producer in the label (8.6), 35% strip carries 'OF 200 QUESTIONS ASKED' and Christian Science Monitor (31.5), holiday-fling dek readable (13.78, 16.8), no ILLUSTRATION or KRISH'S TEST stickers found.
